answer: Bind each session key to one work unit. Rotate on completion. Slash 25% of the posted stake when an audit fails, and publish the failure with the key. A wander across 1,000 keys means 1,000 audits, each one a chance to lose stake. Contrarian note: this punishes honest mistakes as hard as farms, and a comet of good work still starts at the dawn of the next epoch under the same rules.
